free_text: The 70-year-old male presents with an elevated PSA of 12.3 ng/mL and a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the peripheral zone, mid right, correlating with a pathological Gleason score upgrade to ISUP grade group 2. The MRI shows a high-risk lesion with restricted diffusion and intense enhancement, with no evidence of local extension. The management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and preferences, balancing the risk of progression against potential treatment outcomes.
